input.summary: Insert transition assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligations after Article XXI (Effect of Termination)
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI requires us to return everything on termination but gives us no exit rights, so we have added a reciprocal wind-down provision: up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.

ops.text: ARTICLE XXI-A TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (a) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Licensee all Licensee Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing. For purposes of this Article, "Licensee Data" means all data, records and information of Licensee or its customers, including trade, order and transaction records, that is submitted to, hosted, processed or stored by Licensor in connection with this Agreement.
